description: Operational E2E Contract Matrix for Interactive HTML Content Onboarding (Mindmap & Practical Experiments)

cases.preconditions: Content Manager session active, target subject and lesson exist in DRAFT container
cases.input: Valid Excel metadata sheet (lesson_id, title, content_type=HTML_INTERACTIVE) + valid ZIP archive containing index.html, styles.css, script.js, asset images, manifest.json
steps: Upload Excel metadata sheet to ingestion endpoint
Upload ZIP archive matching package code
Validate archive structure and manifest SHA-256 digest
Stage assets in temporary staging bucket
cases.expected_result: Package accepted with HTTP 201 Created, status set to DRAFT_VERIFIED, SHA-256 registered, staged without errors
cases.security_invariant: SEC-PKG-01: Package must pass zip-slip, symlink, and checksum validation before staging
cases.evidence_required: Ingestion audit log entry, calculated bundle SHA-256 digest, staging directory file inventory receipt
cases.cleanup: Purge temporary staging directory and remove uploaded test package artifact

cases.preconditions: Package ingestion endpoint running, pre-extraction security filter enabled
cases.input: ZIP archive containing path traversal entry header '../../etc/passwd' or compression ratio exceeding 100:1 (Zip Bomb)
steps: Submit malformed ZIP archive to upload stream
Trigger archive header pre-unzip inspection
Verify extraction termination before disk write
cases.expected_result: Package rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request and error code UNSAFE_ZIP_ARCHIVE_REJECTED, 0 bytes extracted
cases.security_invariant: SEC-ZIP-01: Absolute path traversal, relative parent escapes, and compression bomb ratios must be blocked before decompression
cases.evidence_required: Security scanner alert log, extraction rejection stack trace, zero-file write confirmation log
cases.cleanup: Purge quarantined stream buffer and close file handle

cases.preconditions: Static HTML/JS AST security validator active in upload preflight
cases.input: ZIP package with index.html containing '<script src="https://cdn.external-domain.com/malicious.js"></script>' or remote fetch calls
steps: Parse index.html DOM and script references
Inspect script tag src attributes and inline dynamic fetch/XHR URIs
Evaluate against strict origin CSP whitelist policy
cases.expected_result: Validation failure with error code EXTERNAL_JS_NOT_ALLOWED, package upload rejected
cases.security_invariant: SEC-JS-01: Remote JavaScript scripts, external CDN links, and external dynamic imports are strictly forbidden; all assets must be bundled internally
cases.evidence_required: Static AST analyzer violation report listing forbidden URI line number

cases.preconditions: ZIP stream directory header inspector enabled
cases.input: ZIP archive containing symlink file header pointing to '/etc/shadow' or 'C:\Windows\System32\config\SAM' or relative symlinks
steps: Scan ZIP central directory headers
Check file system entry attribute flags for symbolic/hard link mode bits
Abort extraction upon link flag detection
cases.expected_result: HTTP 400 rejection with error code SYMLINK_TRAVERSAL_REJECTED, extraction aborted immediately
cases.security_invariant: SEC-FS-01: Symbolic links, hard links, and directory traversal tokens ('../') in entry paths are prohibited
cases.evidence_required: Zip header inspection audit log with symlink entry metadata details
cases.cleanup: Close archive handle and delete temp upload file

cases.preconditions: Mindmap schema definition v1 active
cases.input: Valid HTML5 interactive mindmap bundle (content_type=HTML_MINDMAP) with offline node expand/collapse JS, clean DOM, and structured node JSON
steps: Upload mindmap HTML bundle with metadata content_type='HTML_MINDMAP'
Execute headless DOM rendering verification
Verify node expand/collapse interaction handlers function in sandboxed iframe
cases.expected_result: Package ingested, schema validated as valid HTML_MINDMAP, status set to IN_REVIEW
cases.security_invariant: SEC-CT-01: Mindmap assets must run entirely offline inside sandboxed iframe without top navigation permission
cases.evidence_required: Headless DOM snapshot, sandbox console log showing 0 policy errors

cases.preconditions: Practical experiment schema definition v1 active
cases.input: Valid HTML5 practical experiment simulation bundle (content_type=HTML_EXPERIMENT) using Canvas 2D / WebGL with reset handler and state listener
steps: Upload experiment simulation bundle
Validate offline asset manifest completeness
Verify postMessage event protocol compliance for experiment completion
cases.expected_result: Package validated and registered as HTML_EXPERIMENT, checksum locked for review
cases.security_invariant: SEC-CT-02: Experiments must expose standardized postMessage interface for state saving without direct localStorage access to parent domain
cases.evidence_required: postMessage contract verification log, isolated canvas render screenshot

cases.preconditions: HTML content item created by content_manager in DRAFT status
cases.input: Student API request GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/contents or UI lesson page navigation
steps: Authenticate as student user
Issue query to retrieve lesson contents
Inspect returned content items list
cases.expected_result: Draft HTML content item is NOT returned in response payload (omitted or HTTP 404)
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VIS-01: DRAFT state content is strictly hidden from student role endpoints
cases.evidence_required: API HTTP response payload demonstrating zero draft item exposure

cases.preconditions: HTML content item submitted for review in IN_REVIEW status
cases.input: Student API request GET /api/v1/assets/{asset_id} or direct CDN URL access
steps: Authenticate as student user
Attempt direct asset download query for IN_REVIEW item
cases.expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden or HTTP 404 Not Found
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VIS-02: IN_REVIEW state content is inaccessible to students
cases.evidence_required: HTTP 403 Forbidden response payload and security log entry

cases.preconditions: HTML content item reviewed and marked APPROVED by reviewer, but not yet published
cases.input: Student attempts to fetch lesson curriculum structure
steps: Authenticate as student user
Send GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/contents request
cases.expected_result: APPROVED item remains hidden from student API response prior to explicit publication by publisher
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VIS-03: APPROVED items require explicit publication step by publisher before student distribution
cases.evidence_required: API payload log verifying item exclusion

cases.preconditions: HTML content item transitioned to PUBLISHED status by publisher
cases.input: Student opens published lesson page in web app
steps: Authenticate as student user
Request lesson content items list
Verify sandboxed iframe target URL generation with signed scoped token
cases.expected_result: Published item IS returned in response, iframe URL generates correctly with isolated sandbox origin
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VIS-04: Published assets served only via origin-isolated sandboxed paths with read-only tokens
cases.evidence_required: API response payload containing PUBLISHED status and lesson ID match
cases.cleanup: Reset publication status in test mock

cases.preconditions: Active student token session
cases.input: Requests to administrative endpoints POST /api/v1/admin/content/upload, POST /api/v1/admin/content/publish
steps: Issue admin API HTTP POST request using student bearer token
Observe gateway authorization evaluation
cases.expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden on all administrative content endpoints
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RBAC-01: Admin endpoints enforce strict role checks allowing only content_manager, reviewer, publisher, or admin
cases.evidence_required: HTTP 403 authorization refusal response log

cases.preconditions: User has role content_manager without publisher role
cases.input: POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish request
steps: Upload HTML content package successfully as content_manager (status=DRAFT)
Attempt to invoke direct publish endpoint POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish
cases.expected_result: Upload succeeds with HTTP 201; publish attempt fails with HTTP 403 INSUFFICIENT_PUBLISH_PERMISSIONS
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RBAC-02: Content managers cannot publish content without holding publisher role (separation of duties)
cases.evidence_required: Successful upload receipt and rejected publish HTTP 403 audit log

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is IN_REVIEW
cases.input: Review decision POST /api/v1/content/{id}/review with decision='APPROVE' and review_notes
steps: Authenticate as reviewer
Fetch staging preview package and inspect HTML asset
Submit approval payload to review endpoint
cases.expected_result: Status transitions from IN_REVIEW to APPROVED, audit log records reviewer ID and approval timestamp
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-01: Status transition IN_REVIEW -> APPROVED requires authorized reviewer role and recorded review audit
cases.evidence_required: State transition database record and reviewer audit log entry
cases.cleanup: Revert state transition in test context

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is APPROVED
cases.input: Publication request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish
steps: Authenticate as publisher
Verify content status is APPROVED
Execute publication request
cases.expected_result: Status transitions from APPROVED to PUBLISHED, distribution cache warmed, student API updated
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-02: Only APPROVED items can be transitioned to PUBLISHED by publisher role
cases.evidence_required: Publication audit record, status change event, cache invalidation receipt

cases.preconditions: Version v1.0 of HTML content is currently PUBLISHED
cases.input: Upload new ZIP package for existing content ID
steps: Upload new ZIP package for existing content code
Verify system version assignment and status
cases.expected_result: System creates new draft version v1.1; published v1.0 remains intact and active for students without silent overwrite
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VER-01: Published versions are immutable; updates create distinct version records until explicitly published
cases.evidence_required: Database multi-version list showing v1.0 PUBLISHED and v1.1 DRAFT

cases.preconditions: HTML content v1.0 is currently PUBLISHED and visible to students
cases.input: Unpublish request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/unpublish with reason='Content Update Required'
steps: Authenticate as publisher
Execute unpublish action
Query student lesson API
cases.expected_result: Status changes to UNPUBLISHED, item immediately revoked from student lesson payload, CDN asset URL invalidated
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-03: Unpublish immediately purges distribution cache and blocks student access
cases.evidence_required: CDN purge confirmation response and student API 404 payload

cases.preconditions: HTML content v2.0 is PUBLISHED, v1.0 is ARCHIVED
cases.input: Rollback request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/rollback with target_version='v1.0'
steps: Authenticate as publisher
Execute rollback to v1.0
Verify production pointer and SHA-256 digest match original v1.0
cases.expected_result: Active published pointer restored to v1.0 digest, v2.0 marked SUPERSEDED_ROLLED_BACK, audit event logged
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VER-02: Rollback must atomically restore verified historical digest and produce explicit audit trail
cases.evidence_required: Pointer update log, SHA-256 digest match confirmation for v1.0

cases.preconditions: Package manifest specifies expected SHA-256 hash digest
cases.input: ZIP archive uploaded with altered contents (computed SHA-256 does not match manifest hash)
steps: Receive package upload stream
Compute SHA-256 digest of received stream
Compare computed hash with manifest expected_hash parameter
cases.expected_result: Upload rejected with error code HASH_MISMATCH_DETECTED, temporary upload discarded
cases.security_invariant: SEC-TMP-01: Package digest integrity must match manifest before unzipping or registering
cases.evidence_required: Cryptographic hash mismatch error log with expected vs actual digest values

cases.preconditions: Student conducting interactive HTML experiment
cases.input: Forged window.postMessage or un-signed API request POST /api/v1/progress/complete with score=100 without valid HMAC token
steps: Receive completion progress telemetry request
Validate HMAC token signature and step completion timestamps
cases.expected_result: Progress completion rejected with error INVALID_TELEMETRY_SIGNATURE, event logged in security audit
cases.security_invariant: SEC-TMP-02: Interactive completion events must carry valid HMAC signature issued by session server
cases.evidence_required: HMAC validation rejection log and security audit alert

cases.preconditions: Client-side JS scanner enabled in asset ingestion scanner
cases.input: HTML package containing plaintext answer key array (e.g., 'var correct_answers = ["A", "C", "B"]') in client JS
steps: Scan JavaScript and HTML source files inside package
Identify plaintext solution data patterns
cases.expected_result: Package rejected with error CORRECT_ANSWER_LEAKAGE_DETECTED; require server-side evaluation or hashed validation
cases.security_invariant: SEC-TMP-03: Client-side interactive bundles must not expose raw unhashed correct answers in source code
cases.evidence_required: Static code analysis report highlighting detected solution key leakage line

cases.preconditions: HTML content package cached for offline PWA execution
cases.input: Client app launches cached HTML asset in offline mode
steps: Service Worker reads cached index.html and scripts
Computes local SHA-256 hash of cached file assets
Verifies computed hash against signed manifest.sha256 in local storage
cases.expected_result: Validation succeeds and asset renders in sandbox; if tampered, displays OFFLINE_INTEGRITY_COMPROMISED fallback
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RES-01: Offline cached assets must be validated against signed manifest before execution
cases.evidence_required: Service worker client integrity check log

cases.preconditions: Mobile runtime (PWA wrapper / mobile app WebView) requests HTML asset launch
cases.input: Mobile execution request evaluated against isolation capability checks
steps: Intercept mobile WebView launch request
Verify WebView sandbox configuration (allow-same-origin removed, javascript bridge access restricted)
Check feature flag mobile_html_runtime_enabled
cases.expected_result: Mobile HTML execution remains DISABLED (MOBILE_RUNTIME_DISABLED_UNISOLATED) until sandbox isolation proof is verified
cases.security_invariant: SEC-ISO-01: Mobile runtime must restrict native bridges and enforce full WebView sandbox isolation before enabling
cases.evidence_required: WebView security capability verification report and feature flag block proof

cases.preconditions: Multi-file upload stream active
cases.input: Network connection drops mid-transfer after sending 50% of ZIP package stream
steps: Simulate network disconnect during upload POST
Ingestion daemon timeout triggers clean-up transaction handler
cases.expected_result: Upload transaction aborted, partial temp files deleted atomically, content state remains unchanged with 0 orphan files
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RES-02: Package uploads must be atomic; failed streams leave zero persistent footprint
cases.evidence_required: Cleanup handler execution log and storage audit proving 0 orphan files
cases.cleanup: Run automated orphan file sweeper verification

cases.preconditions: Upload attempt previously aborted or timed out with request ID REQ_884920
cases.input: Client retries upload using identical Idempotency-Key header 'REQ_884920' and payload hash
steps: Send POST upload request with header Idempotency-Key: REQ_884920
Server checks idempotency lock registry
Process upload safely without duplicate records
cases.expected_result: Upload completes idempotently without creating duplicate database rows or storage allocations
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RES-03: Retries matching idempotency key return deterministic result without state duplication
cases.evidence_required: Idempotency handler log showing key hit and single entity creation

cases.preconditions: Content operational lifecycle actions executed (upload, review, publish, unpublish)
cases.input: Lifecycle operation execution events
steps: Execute sequence of lifecycle actions
Query content_audit_trail log table
cases.expected_result: Every operation produces immutable audit log entry containing actor_id, action_type, resource_id, timestamp, IP, and payload digest
cases.security_invariant: SEC-AUD-01: Operational actions must create append-only, tamper-evident audit records
cases.evidence_required: Structured JSON audit log entries verifying mandatory audit fields
cases.cleanup: Retain audit log records in archive

cases.preconditions: Stale temp files or decommissioned test bundles exist in staging storage
cases.input: Automated garbage collection routine execution trigger
steps: Identify temp upload files older than retention threshold (>24 hours)
Execute garbage collector sweeper job
Verify storage bucket inventory
cases.expected_result: Stale files removed from storage, database references cleaned up, audit log of cleanup recorded
cases.security_invariant: SEC-CLN-01: Temp scratch files and orphaned assets must not persist past retention limits
cases.evidence_required: Garbage collection summary log showing deleted asset count and reclaimed storage bytes
